source_documents.title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Photophysical Investigation of a Dyad Comprising 8‐Methyl‐2‐phenylimidazo[1,2‐ a ]pyridine and N ‐methyl Maleimide for Photoinduced Electron Transfer

reference_evidence_units.quote: A broad absorption band in the low-energy region indicates the formation of ground state intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) complex in the IP-NMM dyad.
reference_evidence_units.subject: IP-NMM

reference_evidence_units.quote: The photoexcited ICT complex of the IP-NMM dyad gives rise to a broad fluorescence emission band at an even lower energy region.
reference_evidence_units.subject: IP-NMM

reference_evidence_units.quote: Our observations indicate the occurrence of photoinduced intramolecular electron transfer (ET) in the IPNMM dyad with a first-order ET rate constant ∼ 1010 s−1 in liquid medium.
reference_evidence_units.subject: IP-NMM
reference_evidence_units.statement: IP fluorescence is quenched by intramolecular ET (k ~ 10^10 s-1).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Rate from multi-exponential decays of the IP component.
